Lantern dims beside the awakening thaw
I mend lenses while rain loosens
Gulls return, and green horizons widen
Hearts once lonely learn patient welcome

Tending bright lamps, I greet tides
Harbor bells answer beneath the sun
Oars carry voices toward my tower
Under warm stars, hope steadies quietly

Storms gather, copper clouds darken above
Each departing ship receives my blessing
Keen winds test the faithful lantern
Evening settles, and I release leaves

Endless frost seals every harbor entrance
Patiently, I guard the sleeping sea
Each frozen wave reflects remembered fire
Renewed dawn finds me beneath snow

1. Word counts: 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6.
2. Acrostic: LIGHTHOUSEKEEPER.
3. Structure and progression: four four-line stanzas, moving from spring through summer and autumn to winter; emotional arc is coherent.
4. Stanza endings: thaw, sun, leaves, snow.
5. The poem contains no hyphens, numerals, or contractions.
